thread:
ana: heads-up: new CVE (CVE-2026-0420) in go-kms-client v2.0.0-2.1.3 — path traversal in URI normalization. upstream fixed in v2.1.4. public PoC on GH gist.

ana: impact summary: can reach key material outside tenant prefix if attacker can control URI input. CVSS 8.1 (High), exploitability moderate (PoC requires crafted request but no auth bypass).

brian: quick triage — which surfaces use the library? I think private agent, dedicated connectors, and our kms-proxy for self-serve hosted (but hosted frontends validate). Dedicated customers often run connectors unmodified.

mira: confirmed: Dedicated connector images vendor the client; private agent does too. Hosted uses an additional validation layer, but there are some older canary pods still on 2.0.x.

zoe: legal/security note: PoC public -> assume timeline compresses. Recommend short embargo on details in customer comms until patch is applied to all Dedicated pools.

ana: proposed actions:
- Mitigate immediate exposure: push an ingress rule to block suspicious KMS URIs (deny if contains `..` or non-whitelisted scheme). Enable audit marker on blocked attempts.
- Dedicated: treat high priority — hot patch images to v2.1.4 and rotate connector pools within 24-36h.
- Hosted: staged rollout to canary subset (1%) for 3h, then 5%, 20%, 100% over 48h assuming no regressions.
- RBAC check: add temporary policy to KMS ACLs to enforce tenant prefix requirement for service principals where possible.
- Communication: draft customer advisory for Dedicated + Enterprise immediately; hosted users get notification only if exploit confirmed.

ana: onboarding checklist for infra:
```
# bump deps
replace github.com/redwood/go-kms-client => github.com/upstream/go-kms-client v2.1.4
make image-kmsclient-upgrade
# deploy canary
kubectl -n prod-canary set image deploy/kms-proxy kms=redwood/kms:2.1.4
```

brian: rollout policy: auto-rollback if >0.5% 5xx or latency p95 increases >300ms for 10m. Also create telemetry events for `kms.uri.suspicious` and `kms.uri.normalized_outside_prefix` to detect attempts or misnormalization.

mira: I'll own Dedicated image build + pool rotation with SRE. Plan: start tonight 0100 UTC, rotate nodes per-customer group to minimize blast radius. Will add preflight that asserts audit log entries are being emitted.

sam: legal ok with draft approach. Also request security-comms to prepare a short FAQ and escalation matrix. We should not notify customers until we have Dedicated remediation scheduled.

ana: adding a temporary config flag in kms-proxy to hard-fail unknown schemes and to run URI canonicalization stricter. That buys time for library update.

zoe: suggest issuing temporary customer-facing guidance for connectors: "If you vendor go-kms-client, upgrade to v2.1.4 or contact support for assistance." Keep it targeted to Dedicated/Enterprise.

mira: gateway rule pushed to WAF with audit:true. Routing to /audit/kms-uri. Blocking for high-confidence matches.

deploy-bot: CI passed for kms-proxy#kms-upgrade-1975 (unit/integration). Image pushed: redwood/kms:2.1.4

brian: OK. mira, start canary in prod-canary and wire telemetry. I'll instrument dashboards and alerts.

mira: canary started. will wait 2h for health and audit anomalies.

ana: customer comms owners: ana (draft), zoe (security-comms copy), sam (legal). Please keep thread updated.

brian: one more ask: run a quick scan across infra for any other packages that import go-kms-client to catch shadowed vendoring. Use `go list -m all` across repos.

mira: doing that now; will report results in 30m.

ana: decision on prioritization: Dedicated = T0 (hotfix, SLA at risk if exploitable), Hosted = T1 (guard+staged rollout). Notify CSMs for dedicated accounts with high crypto/SLA needs.

sam: approved. legal to queue notification template.

mira: found two additional repos vendoring v2.0.9 (private-agent and legacy-connector). Adding them to patch plan.

ana: updated schedule: start Dedicated image rotates in 6h (to respect business hours for some customers), full Dedicated patch complete in 36h. Hosted full rollout target 72h.

brian: good. make sure rollback playbooks are in place and that we can quickly revoke connector credentials if signs of misuse appear.

ana: assigning action items: ana: draft & file incident doc; mira: patch+rotate; brian: telemetry & rollback hooks; zoe: customer advisory drafts; sam: legal review.

mira: beginning builds and will post logs to the incident doc.

deploy-bot: Dedicated rotation job started: job/rot-kms-dedicated-1975 (status: running)

ana: will reopen thread if we detect exploitation or need exec escalation. Otherwise we'll close after postmortem in ~2 weeks.

brian: thanks team. If any customer reports strange key access patterns, pause and alert immediately.

mira: noted — will pause rotation if anomalies in /audit/kms-uri exceed threshold.
